summary.answer: MapVote directly constructs decided/random/previous/next entries. Builds image, name/mode layout, overlay/backing, vote text/count, brackets/marker/button outline. Selected and Unselectable defaults are AlwaysFalse; MapVote parent merges Selected=true on decided entry and Previous-selectability condition on previous. Thus exact caller override matters; own default false does not exclude those states globally. Qualified reset/state/focus clips change selection/disable visuals and exact timing; __onClose closes layout/backing/button-outline through CallOriginalSecond. No confirm/network vote call here; parent unit179 owns it. Optional postload then self return.
